units.source_text: 被方形铜板隔成一格一格的锅子里，豆浆表面渐渐凝固，结成一层豆皮，

en.t: In a pot divided into square compartments by copper plates, the surface of the soy milk gradually congealed, forming a sheet of tofu skin,

units.source_text: 干活的人用竹筷子熟练地把它捞上来，晾在上面细细的竹架上。

en.t: and the workers skillfully lifted it out with bamboo chopsticks and laid it to dry on the thin bamboo racks above.

units.source_text: 架子上下几层，豆皮干了，挨次往上挪。

en.t: The racks had several tiers, and as the tofu skin dried, it was moved upward in order.
